name: supplier-chase
title: Supplier delivery follow-up draft
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM suppliers ORDER BY name

sections.title: Outstanding deliveries
sections.note: Draft for review. Nothing has been sent. Confirm the requested dates against the supplier evidence.
sections.sql: SELECT reference,item,outstanding,needed_on,promise_on,reason FROM expedite_queue WHERE supplier_id=$1 ORDER BY needed_on

sections.title: Open follow-ups
sections.sql: SELECT d.reference,f.note,f.owner,f.due_on FROM followups f JOIN delivery_position d ON d.id=f.line_id WHERE d.supplier_id=$1 AND f.closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.due_on

name: receipt-record
title: Goods receipt working record
for_each: SELECT id,reference AS name FROM delivery_position ORDER BY reference

sections.title: Delivery dockets
sections.note: Opening received balances have no inferred date. Retain original receipt documents separately.
sections.sql: SELECT reference,received_on,quantity,evidence,actor FROM receipts WHERE line_id=$1 ORDER BY received_on

name: promise-review
title: Supplier promise decision record
for_each: SELECT id,reference AS name FROM delivery_position ORDER BY reference

sections.title: Recorded proposals
sections.sql: SELECT proposed_on,evidence,actor,decision,decided_by,decision_reason,decided_at FROM promises WHERE line_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at,id
